config.hypothesis: At e<=0.9, the loss of linear accel_step decodability is a lower ceiling, not slower convergence. Setup: N=64, 4 layers, d_model=64, m2 in [0.1, 1], data_seed 0, best-of-5 controls, seeds 70-72, 3000 steps. Prediction: final raw layer-4 accel_step R2 stays at least 0.08 below the same seeds' 3000-step e<=0.85 values (0.573/0.558/0.588, f-20261013-001616-659c), that is at most 0.493/0.478/0.508. The headroom-normalised margin also stays below 0.40, while accel_step still beats its control. Values come from probes_final at the best-margin layer, unrounded. The layer-4 value is reported separately if layer 4 is not the best-margin layer. The 600-step e<=0.9 values (0.393/0.396/0.436) are the within-seed starting point for growth.
